notes.title: Haru to Shura : Chinese version (simplified Chinese) will be released!
notes.notes:
The Chinese version will be released on World Translation Day, September 30, 2021. 
Translation and implementation is almost complete and is currently being tested.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38184176/f5c0403e02f5e8670ec1908e5ed03beb174daa08.png

After the update, we will make another announcement here.

Stay healthy, stay tuned!

notes.title: Haru to Shura ver.1.00.6 update announcement
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed.
-When entering the hospital just before delivering the scarf, if you moved in the opposite direction, the screen would stay dark.

The following has been added
-Prompts you to save just before the story branches with an important choice.
-A system message is displayed when the pocket is full.

The above has been fixed.
Please update to the latest version before playing.

Thank you for your support by purchasing and playing "Haru to Shura", reviewing it, reporting bugs, helping us identify bugs, following us on Twitter and RT.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Haru to Shura ver.1.00.4 update announcement
notes.notes:
Fixed:
-The game stops progressing after you get the acroons in the tomb.
-Chihiro is lying down and has his foot on Yoru's knee.

The above has been fixed.
Before playing, please update to version 1.00.4.
If it doesn't update, please try logging out again.

*If you start from the save data right before the event where you get the acroons at the tomb, you will need to insert another scene right before the event in order to examine the tomb and get the acroons.

We would like to thank everyone who has purchased and played "Haru to Shura", reviewed it, reported bugs, helped us identify bugs, followed us on Twitter, and RT'd us.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: [Release Date] "Haru to Shura" to be Released on June 24
notes.notes:
Thank you for registering your wishlist, playing the demo version, reporting bugs, and commenting.

We are pleased to announce that the full version of "Haru to Shura" will be released on June 24, 2021.
We will be releasing the full version on June 24, 2021, which was announced as June 11 at Indie Live Expo. The request for correction did not arrive in time for the broadcast date.

The original soundtrack "Haru:Note" will also be released as DLC on the same day.

[previewyoutube=77-a_6z1ZCU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ［Apology] The save data of the trial version will be lost.
notes.notes:
Due to the change of save format from auto to manual, the save data of the demo version will be lost with the latest update!
With the change, there are now three save slots and you can choose where to save.
This is the result of major improvements, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38184176/4518be3b2abe83239a9a137739f7819dcd8c4a97.jpg

In addition, the demo version has been updated as follows
-Added support for high refresh rate environments.
-Increased the number of hints in the game (you can sit on the couch)
-Adjusted screen size
-Added and fixed some dialogues and CG
-Sometimes you can eat at the bar

Then we'll have a release date announcement soon.
Follow us on Twitter, stay tuned, and stay healthy.

MIYAKO publ. on Twitter

notes.title: Announcement: Haru to Shura demo version released and full release postponed
notes.notes:
- The demo version of Haru to Shura has now been released, which takes around 20-30 minutes to complete. You can download the demo version on the store page.
* The save data from the demo version cannot be transferred to the full version.

- Haru to Shura was planned for release in November 2020, but will have to be postponed for the time being to raise funds. We will let you know when the full game is planned to be released here or on our official Twitter, @miyakoshuppan.
